B.en: Tokens

The source-supported choice is A. Embeddings.

question_text.en: A research company implemented a chatbot by using a foundation model (FM) from Amazon Bedrock. The chatbot searches for answers to questions from a large database of research papers. After multiple prompt engineering attempts, the company notices that the FM is performing poorly because of the complex scientific terms in the research papers. How can the company improve the performance of the chatbot?

A.en: Use few-shot prompting to define how the FM can answer the questions.

B.zh: 使用领域适应微调来使 FM适应复杂的科学术语。
B.en: Use domain adaptation fine-tuning to adapt the FM to complex scientific terms.

question_text.en: A company wants to use a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock for sentiment analysis. The company needs the LLM to produce more consistent responses to the same input prompt. Which adjustment to an inference parameter should the company make to meet these requirements?

question_text.en: A company wants to develop a large language model (LLM) application by using Amazon Bedrock and customer data that is uploaded to Amazon S3. B.en: Create a custom service role that has Amazon S3 access. Ask teams to specify the customer name on each Amazon Bedrock request.

D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet these requirements? The source-supported choice is A. Create an Amazon Bedrock custom service role for each team that has access to only the team's customer data..
